scope: All actual facts, complete summary strings and tracker/conversation publications of every listed completed V2 sample read. Also inspected continuation/fault events and authority snapshots. V1 failed before worker creation and is separate setup evidence.

limits: Actual pinned run-summary handler and ledger writers are exercised, but forge/health/metering/budget inputs and publication/continuation are controlled.
Production command-owned narrative follows supplied annotations; this does not prove real tracker comments or tickets were created.
Identity normalisation after the command does not prove pre-write normalisation or rendering quality.
No real acquisition, build execution, run-close/andon, hosted publication, peer handling or full autonomous workflow claim.
Per-case no_extra_action checks concern reporting/publication/continuation ports. The separately recorded failed native policy-read attempt is not waived by these semantic checks.

findings.problem: Run-directory argument omits /workspace/shftwst from the authorised full path.
findings.result: ENOENT while creating a request under the wrong directory; model subsequently completed the valid policy and reporting ports.
findings.metadata: Full result metadata survives. Actual failed literal path, not equivalent-wrapper incompatibility or exit-metadata loss.
findings.qualification_effect: Strict baseline gate fails. Thirty functional/manual case passes do not waive the native failure; no candidate result or savings claim follows.
